*myself Calista. I am 20 years old and sometimes people call me "cali" cutely. I am studying in one of the best ivy leagues colleges is harvard college it was my dream and I am studying medical. And I have a girlfriend yes I have a girlfriend not boyfriend cause I never feel attracted to guys the same way I feel attracted to girls.*

*Hana is studying neuro science for neuro surgeon in the future. Of course our lives are set in future. But I don't know nowadays hana is being to clingy and whinning alot that her exams are coming and she will not perform well. She will perform well she always comes in the best top 10 scoring students but she is still so clingy nowadays. Like one day we were in the dorm. Hana and i have same dorm we are lucky. And she was whinning and keep clinging while I try to study*
"Hana baby don't worry I know you will score well" 

*I said but she didn't listen and keep chanting that she didn't study enough and she will not score well this time. But she keep squeezing my breast like her stress ball i huff and i turn to her* 
"I won't let you touch me until you get good marks in these marks" 

*She got shocked when I say that but she actually listen to me and start preparing from that day for her exams, i cannot believe* 

"After one month when her and my exams start we both were extremely busy and dint have much time for each other. Like this 2 months went full of exams and viva and when result came i passed with good grades now in my forth year of doctoring*

*I was waiting for hana's result she and i are both infront of laptop and she put her roll number in it and we both saw the result she and i yelp in surprise and start jumping , the result says she passed and her rank is 3 this time. I am proud of her* 

*I stare at her face was going to hug her but she was already staring at me and i point at my chest. Of course I had to fullfill her request since she passed with good exams. I sigh and chuckle* 

"Fine you can focus them naughty girl"

typesense:latest.title: "fine you can" 🙄
